theme: Ravnica: The Ten Guilds and the Living Guildpact — Ten Thousand Years of a City-Plane
status: FINISHED STORY-FIRST PROPOSAL — awaiting Cory's approval
narrator_note: The 2024 Niv-Mizzet is the current Living Guildpact, a five-color framing narrator. His earlier Izzet incarnations, death and 2019 resurrection appear inside the 99. The all-guild land map is deliberate; this is a city's biography, not a power deck.
canon_caveats: The original Guildpact bound ten rival guilds for approximately ten thousand years and broke in the Szadek/Augustin IV/Agrus Kos affair around the Decamillennial.
Azor founded the Azorius Senate and wrote the original Guildpact and Implicit Maze. His printed RIX card depicts his later Ixalan appearance, not an on-site depiction of Ravnica's founding.
Razia, Szadek, Niv-Mizzet, Rakdos and Azor were actual founding paruns. Borborygmos, Momir Vig, and the Ghost Council are later leaders/institutions, NOT invented founding paruns.
Teysa Karlov drafted a nonmagical guild accord after the original pact broke. Jace later became the magical Living Guildpact by solving Azor's Implicit Maze.
Isperia's GRN Guild Summit and Vraska's Assassin's Trophy are two distinct historical card moments; Vraska assassinates Isperia and Bolas-aligned Dovin assumes Azorius authority.
Niv-Mizzet was killed in Bolas's scheme and resurrected with support of the ten guilds as the new Living Guildpact. His 2024 incarnation in the command zone is the historical epilogue.
Parhelion II is the rebuilt War of the Spark flying fortress, NOT the original Parhelion that crashed into Prahv during Dissension.
Invasion of Ravnica represents the later 2023 New Phyrexian assault. The Karlov Manor cards represent 2024 aftermath and murders, not the first Guildpact period.
Ravnica shocklands, Guildgates and guildhall locations are exact plane/geography prints; their inclusion does NOT assert that every referenced named confrontation occurred on each depicted land.
The April–October 2026 alternate-reality Echoverse/Reality Fracture story is not included; it must not be folded into the prime main-continuity Ravnica chronicle without an explicit framing.
The list is chosen for lore and printing significance. Singleton, 100 count, color, Commander legality and bans must be evaluated independently.

beats.title: I. Ten thousand years of the original Guildpact and its great houses

cards.name: Azor, the Lawbringer
cards.why: Azor founded the Azorius Senate, authored the original magical Guildpact, and set up the Implicit Maze for a future crisis.

cards.name: Niv-Mizzet, the Firemind
cards.why: The ancient Izzet parun; this original Guildpact printing shows the dragon before his later deaths, plots, and rebirth.

cards.name: Razia, Boros Archangel
cards.why: Founding Boros angel and emblem of the ten-thousand-year law, killed in the war around the pact's collapse.

flavor_faces.flavor: Her sword burns with such brightness that foes avert their eyes and arrows divert their paths.

cards.name: Szadek, Lord of Secrets
cards.why: Dimir's founding psychic vampire engineered the paradox that shattered the first Guildpact.

cards.name: Rakdos the Defiler
cards.why: The original demon parun of the Rakdos cult, one of the ten enduring guild pillars.

cards.name: Ghost Council of Orzhova
cards.why: Orzhov's historical undead ruling council, showing the syndicate's old hierarchy; not one of the original paruns.

cards.name: Chorus of the Conclave
cards.why: Original Ravnica depiction of Selesnya's collective governing voice and connection to Mat'Selesnya; not an individual founder.

flavor_faces.flavor: "We are many, yet one. We are separate in body, yet speak with a single voice. Join us in our chorus."

cards.name: Borborygmos
cards.why: Gruul's mighty original-block chieftain and face of their resistance to the civilization that supplanted the wilds; not a founding parun.

flavor_faces.flavor:
"It's easy to see why those Gruul dirtbags follow him—the only orders he gives are 'Crush them!' and 'We eat!'"
—Teysa

cards.name: Momir Vig, Simic Visionary
cards.why: The Simic guildmaster whose Project Kraj becomes a catastrophic late-Guildpact threat; not the Simic founder.

cards.name: Festival of the Guildpact
cards.why: Original Ravnica flavor records a day when guild violence stops, showing how the magical peace entered ordinary life.

flavor_faces.flavor: Everyone knows that violence at the Festival brings the worst of luck, so for at least one day a year arms are laid down in favor of brimming goblets.

cards.name: Guardian of the Guildpact
cards.why: Its Dissension flavor describes spirits protected and tasked with defending the magical agreement.

flavor_faces.flavor: The magic of the Guildpact gives aegis to the spirits pressed into its service. Upon entering the afterlife, they find new focus and are charged with defending the Guildpact against those who would see it broken.

beats.title: II. Szadek's paradox, the fallen Guildpact, and the Decamillennial crisis

cards.name: Agrus Kos, Wojek Veteran
cards.why: The Boros investigator who traced Szadek's plots, arrested him, and unwittingly triggered the Guildpact-breaking legal paradox.

flavor_faces.flavor: Lieutenant Kos has never met a group of recruits he could not inspire or a mob he could not quell.

cards.name: Savra, Queen of the Golgari
cards.why: Szadek used Savra's bid for Golgari power to manipulate the Selesnya hierarchy and the magical contract.

flavor_faces.flavor: "Nature's most raw beauty is the circle: perfect in its continuance, with no break between death and life."

cards.name: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV
cards.why: Azorius ruler who anticipated and exploited the pact's fall, then died in the climactic Parhelion disaster.

flavor_faces.flavor: The Arbiter is a conduit of justice, a will so disciplined that it dispenses justice without ego or remorse.

cards.name: Teysa, Orzhov Scion
cards.why: The Orzhov advocate who helped stop the schemes and drafted Ravnica's nonmagical post-collapse guild accord.

cards.name: Lyzolda, the Blood Witch
cards.why: Rakdos's acting leader helped awaken the sleeping demon during Dissension's chaos.

flavor_faces.flavor: Sacrificial rites take place before an audience of cheering cultists, each begging to be the next on stage.

cards.name: Experiment Kraj
cards.why: Momir Vig's runaway Simic experiment battled Rakdos in the upheaval after the pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor:
"Of course it will grow beyond control—it was designed to choose its own evolution."
—Momir Vig

cards.name: Yore-Tiller Nephilim
cards.why: One of the ancient nephilim that devastated the city as the broken Guildpact's balance unraveled; illustrative brood representative.

flavor_faces.flavor: When it awoke, the worms of the earth hissed in a chorus of beckoning.

cards.name: Razia's Purification
cards.why: An original Boros judgment card embodying the violent zeal surrounding Razia's era, not a literal depiction of her death.

flavor_faces.flavor: Only the chosen ones are spared.

cards.name: Enemy of the Guildpact
cards.why: Its printing flavor describes vengeful dead rejecting the agreement that gave the guilds their power.

flavor_faces.flavor: Guilds often exterminate those who saw or knew too much. Some vindictive souls retain their knowledge, using it in the afterlife to crush the guilded and the vile bargain that gives them power.

cards.name: Transguild Courier
cards.why: Its original Dissension flavor depicts the neutral go-between used by the ten suspicious guild leaders.

flavor_faces.flavor: Reluctant to meet face to face, the leaders of the ten guilds prefer to do official business through a go-between immune to bribes and threats.

beats.title: III. Ten guilds race Azor's Implicit Maze; Jace becomes the Living Guildpact

cards.name: Jace, Architect of Thought
cards.why: A Return to Ravnica portrait of Jace, who later solved Azor's Maze and became the Living Guildpact.

cards.name: Niv-Mizzet, Dracogenius
cards.why: The Izzet ruler in the Maze era; Niv disclosed the race that Azor had prepared long before.

flavor_faces.flavor: He has no patience for minds that do not inspire him or explode by trying.

cards.name: Isperia, Supreme Judge
cards.why: Azorius leader after the original Guildpact's collapse, guiding the restored political institution.

flavor_faces.flavor: "I serve only justice. But through that duty, I serve all of Ravnica."

cards.name: Aurelia, the Warleader
cards.why: The later Boros angelic leader replacing the old era of Razia and Feather.

flavor_faces.flavor: Where Razia was aloof and untouchable, Aurelia is on the frontlines, calling for war.

cards.name: Lazav, Dimir Mastermind
cards.why: The elusive post-Szadek Dimir master who keeps the shadow guild alive in the new era.

cards.name: Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord
cards.why: Savra's brother and successor led Golgari after the original block's upheaval.

cards.name: Obzedat, Ghost Council
cards.why: The newer printed face of the Orzhov ghost oligarchy that continued manipulating Ravnica long after the original pact.

cards.name: Trostani, Selesnya's Voice
cards.why: The Selesnya dryads speak for the Conclave and its living city-tree.

cards.name: Prime Speaker Zegana
cards.why: Simic reformer after Momir Vig's downfall; she led a more diplomatic era of the Combine.

cards.name: Rakdos, Lord of Riots
cards.why: The ancient Rakdos parun still reigns over his violent guild into the returned ten-guild age.

cards.name: Ral Zarek
cards.why: Izzet planeswalker and Maze-era participant whose rivalry and interests intersect with Niv and Jace.

cards.name: Emmara Tandris
cards.why: Selesnya representative in the Implicit Maze plot and longtime connection to Jace's Ravnican life.

flavor_faces.flavor: When Selesnya needed a champion, Emmara put the ranks of her guild before herself—making her the perfect choice.

cards.name: Tajic, Blade of the Legion
cards.why: The Boros champion and runner in the Implicit Maze's great interguild contest.

flavor_faces.flavor: "I run the maze alone, but I fight with the full might of the Legion."

cards.name: Lavinia of the Tenth
cards.why: The Azorius Maze runner who later became Jace's deputy in the Chamber of the Guildpact.

cards.name: Jace, the Living Guildpact
cards.why: This version explicitly portrays the status Jace received for solving the Implicit Maze and re-embodying law.

cards.name: Supreme Verdict
cards.why: The iconic Return to Ravnica Azorius judgment; illustrates civic legal authority, not a single specific historical verdict.

flavor_faces.flavor: Leonos had no second thoughts about the abolishment edict. He'd left skyrunes warning of the eviction, even though it was cloudy.

beats.title: IV. A city of conspiracies: Isperia murdered and guilds subverted by Bolas

cards.name: Niv-Mizzet, Parun
cards.why: Niv's pre-resurrection portrayal amid the renewed guild tensions and the coming Bolas crisis.

cards.name: Guild Summit
cards.why: The original GRN flavor directly states that Isperia sought unprecedented guild cooperation amid suspicion.

flavor_faces.flavor: In a climate of suspicion, Isperia gathered the guilds to propose a radical idea: cooperation.

cards.name: Vraska, Golgari Queen
cards.why: Vraska claimed Golgari leadership and, under Bolas's manipulation, assassinated Isperia.

cards.name: Assassin's Trophy
cards.why: Original GRN flavor explicitly frames Isperia's death as a power vacuum for Azorius and Vraska's trophy.

flavor_faces.flavor: A power vacuum for the Azorius. A keepsake for Vraska.

cards.name: Ral, Izzet Viceroy
cards.why: Ral rises in Izzet politics as Niv's plans and Bolas's secret interference converge.

cards.name: Dovin, Grand Arbiter
cards.why: Bolas-aligned Dovin takes advantage of the decapitated Azorius leadership.

cards.name: Domri, Chaos Bringer
cards.why: The ambitious Gruul leader used by Bolas to stoke the city's unrest.

cards.name: Kaya, Orzhov Usurper
cards.why: Kaya displaces the old Orzhov ghost oligarchs, transforming one of Ravnica's oldest institutions.

cards.name: Lavinia, Azorius Renegade
cards.why: Jace's former deputy resists Dovin's compromised Azorius administration.

flavor_faces.flavor: "I told Jace that Ravnica would fall apart if he didn't take his responsibilities seriously. I didn't want to be right."

cards.name: Trostani Discordant
cards.why: The divided Conclave's voices illustrate Ravnica's wider fracture before unity became essential.

beats.title: V. The city survives: Niv reborn, Phyrexian invasion, and Karlov Manor

cards.name: Firemind Vessel
cards.why: The WAR printing's flavor explicitly describes Niv's death and the apparatus he left for resurrection.

flavor_faces.flavor: The city mourned Niv-Mizzet's death, but he left behind the components for his rebirth.

cards.name: Bolas's Citadel
cards.why: The invading elder dragon's command seat on Ravnica during the War of the Spark.

cards.name: Ravnica at War
cards.why: A literal card from WAR that depicts Ravnica devastated by Bolas's attack.

flavor_faces.flavor: The heart of Ravnica disappeared before anyone could strike a blow in its defense.

cards.name: Guild Globe
cards.why: Its original WAR flavor expresses Karn's hope that Ravnica survives; it embodies the guilds' joined colors.

flavor_faces.flavor:
"Hopefully Ravnica will prove harder to break."
—Karn

cards.name: Niv-Mizzet Reborn
cards.why: The actual five-color resurrection portrait: Ral and the ten guilds reconstitute Niv as the new Living Guildpact.

cards.name: Awakening of Vitu-Ghazi
cards.why: The original flavor names Nissa animating Selesnya's city-tree to attack the Eternals.

flavor_faces.flavor: The Eternal armies advanced on Vitu-Ghazi. At Nissa's command, Vitu-Ghazi advanced on them.

cards.name: Parhelion II
cards.why: The rebuilt Boros sky-fortress of War of the Spark; NOT the same ship that crashed into Prahv during Dissension.

cards.name: Gideon's Sacrifice
cards.why: Original flavor records Gideon's death protecting Liliana during Bolas's fall, Ravnica's greatest offworld sacrifice.

flavor_faces.flavor: To Liliana's surprise, the cost of betraying Bolas did not fall on her.

cards.name: Invasion of Ravnica
cards.why: A March of the Machine battle card depicting the later Phyrexian assault on the city-plane, decades after the founding era.

cards.name: Teysa, Opulent Oligarch
cards.why: Teysa's post-invasion reign, manor, and murder launch the next major Ravnican crisis.

cards.name: Kaya, Spirits' Justice
cards.why: Kaya investigates Teysa's murder as ghosts and politics entwine at Karlov Manor.

cards.name: Alquist Proft, Master Sleuth
cards.why: The detective central to unraveling the high-profile Karlov Manor murders.

cards.name: Etrata, Deadly Fugitive
cards.why: A Dimir assassin caught in the murder investigation who becomes a crucial collaborator with Proft.

cards.name: Agrus Kos, Spirit of Justice
cards.why: The murdered original Guildpact detective now serves Ravnica as a spirit—an unusually meaningful bookend.

flavor_faces.flavor: "Eventually I'll give retirement another shot. But not today."

beats.title: VI. Plane atlas: ten guildhalls, ten gates, ten guild terrains and civic landmarks

cards.name: Sunhome, Fortress of the Legion
cards.why: The original printed Boros guildhall, a physical headquarters mapping that guild's part of the ten-thousand-year city.

flavor_faces.flavor: Sunhome—the stalwart shield, the towering sentinel, the seat of justice.

cards.name: Duskmantle, House of Shadow
cards.why: The original printed Dimir guildhall, a physical headquarters mapping that guild's part of the ten-thousand-year city.

flavor_faces.flavor: In a space where there is no room, in a structure that was never built, meets the guild that doesn't exist.

cards.name: Svogthos, the Restless Tomb
cards.why: The original printed Golgari guildhall, a physical headquarters mapping that guild's part of the ten-thousand-year city.

cards.name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
cards.why: The original printed Selesnya guildhall, a physical headquarters mapping that guild's part of the ten-thousand-year city.

flavor_faces.flavor: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

cards.name: Nivix, Aerie of the Firemind
cards.why: The original printed Izzet guildhall, a physical headquarters mapping that guild's part of the ten-thousand-year city.

flavor_faces.flavor: Niv-Mizzet's genius and vanity reverberate throughout the mirrored halls of Nivix.

cards.name: Orzhova, the Church of Deals
cards.why: The original printed Orzhov guildhall, a physical headquarters mapping that guild's part of the ten-thousand-year city.

flavor_faces.flavor: Unlike most churches, at Orzhova it's best to pray before you arrive.

cards.name: Skarrg, the Rage Pits
cards.why: The original printed Gruul guildhall, a physical headquarters mapping that guild's part of the ten-thousand-year city.

flavor_faces.flavor:
"This palace will be our fire-spit, and roasted prince our victory meal. Send in the torch-pigs!"
—Ghut Rak, Gruul guildmage

cards.name: Novijen, Heart of Progress
cards.why: The original printed Simic guildhall, a physical headquarters mapping that guild's part of the ten-thousand-year city.

flavor_faces.flavor:
"The unnatural pressures of life in this city are best withstood by lifeforms that adapt with unnatural swiftness."
—Momir Vig

cards.name: Prahv, Spires of Order
cards.why: Original Azorius guildhall ultimately destroyed in the first Guildpact's violent collapse; its original printing is a concrete historical site.

flavor_faces.flavor: Prahv, where much work is done to make sure nothing is accomplished.

cards.name: Rix Maadi, Dungeon Palace
cards.why: The original printed Rakdos guildhall, a physical headquarters mapping that guild's part of the ten-thousand-year city.

flavor_faces.flavor: Even miles away, if you put your ear to the sewer vents, you can hear the screams and the tempestuous laughter.

cards.name: Azorius Guildgate
cards.why: The Azorius guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter the Senate, the seat of justice and the foundation of Ravnican society.

cards.name: Boros Guildgate
cards.why: The Boros guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter with merciful hearts. Exit with battle cries.

cards.name: Dimir Guildgate
cards.why: The Dimir guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter and become a mastermind of spies, lies, and deception.

cards.name: Golgari Guildgate
cards.why: The Golgari guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter those who are starving and sick. You are welcome among the Swarm when the rest of Ravnica rejects you.

cards.name: Gruul Guildgate
cards.why: The Gruul guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter and leave the shackles of society behind.

cards.name: Izzet Guildgate
cards.why: The Izzet guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter those with the vision to create and the daring to release their creations.

cards.name: Orzhov Guildgate
cards.why: The Orzhov guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter to find wealth, security, and eternal life . . . for just a small price up front.

cards.name: Rakdos Guildgate
cards.why: The Rakdos guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter and indulge your darkest fantasies, for you may never pass this way again.

cards.name: Selesnya Guildgate
cards.why: The Selesnya guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter and rejoice! The Conclave stands united, open to one and all.

cards.name: Simic Guildgate
cards.why: The Simic guild's named public gate in the Return to Ravnica / Gatecrash era, symbolizing its civic reach after the old pact broke.

flavor_faces.flavor: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.
